_readme: Member Portal™ (Omnidirectional Enterprise™ Membership) settings. The portal shows these sections in this order. Built-in types (founders, partnerships, llab) keep their special content; add a new part of The Co.LLab™ later with type "program" (a heading, description, and link). Set enabled to false to hide a section without deleting it. Reward tiers set the TRIARCH™ tier reward price caps for .LLab Membership™.
intro: The Co.LLab Founders Organization™, Partnerships, and .LLab Membership™, in one place. The TRIARCH™ is the legend behind the legacy of the Co.LLab™ Omnidirectional Enterprise™ model.

sections.title: The Co.LLab™
